There are Y-linked traits as well, but because only males have/need the Y-chromosome, there are a lot less genes on this and these are typically only relevant to male development and functioning. This is also why the Y-chromosome is much smaller than the X-chromosome.
So we often use sex-linked and X-linked interchangeable, because most sex-linked traits are X-linked.
